description: A real event, not a hypothetical: the December-2024 GSTR-2B was generated on 16-January-2025 because the GSTR-1 due date had been extended, so the INGESTED statement's own generation date is the resolution instant and the computed 14th is not. Without it a hard-coded 14 passes every other clock case here and then deem-accepts two days before the statement that resolves it even exists.
